subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: What proof is sufficient before attempting a Slack reaction Socket Mode fix for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection shows the handler, filter, and reconnect boundaries, but does not identify whether the real failure is Slack/Bolt non-delivery, OpenClaw account filtering, authorization, or broader Socket Mode liveness.

options.title: Require live reaction-envelope proof
options.body: Keep this open and require redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes plus gateway trace logs before a code change is attempted.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode liveness
options.body: If maintainers believe the symptom is only a stale Socket Mode transport issue, route follow-up through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77249 and preserve this reaction evidence there.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer repro
options.body: Run a maintainer-owned multi-account Slack workspace repro to identify the first missing or dropped event boundary without waiting for more reporter logs.

recommendation.title: Require live reaction-envelope proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open and require redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes plus gateway trace logs before a code change is attempted.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest history across Slack monitor filtering, routing, and Socket Mode ownership signals.
